note: On-yomi per character, extracted once from the Unicode Han Database (Unihan) field kJapaneseOn and converted to katakana. Used ONLY as the last resort, for characters no morphological analyser can read at all, and every reading taken from here is marked uncertain — on-yomi is frequently the wrong reading for a native word, which is exactly what titles are full of.
